notes: The R oracle is NNS_14.2.tar.gz as stored at r_commit, the archive the cache builder downloads. Its R/ and src/ files equal the Git tree at r_commit apart from CRLF line endings and final newlines. The vendored tools/NNS tree, r_src_tree_hash and tools/NNS_13.0.tar.gz identify the historical snapshot. Native overlays are tracked separately from the accepted NNS-core snapshot.

r14_native_overlays.adaptation: R14 gravity/mode port with std::vector marshalling, updated to R 14.2's mode peak rule (strict neighbours, window maximum, end-bin height, paired ties, sorted unique multi-mode centres; no concavity gate or suppression). CMake replaces only the old central-tendency translation unit; vendor rescale behavior is retained (R 14.2's rescale changes are in src/nns/central_tendencies.py).

R14 multilevel/null-corrected dependence with vector marshalling. R::dhyper and R::pnorm are the ports of R's own nmath routines in src/nns/_rnmath.hpp, so the null expectations match R's bit for bit. Bound explicitly instead of the untouched vendor dependence estimator. R 14.2 (r_commit) changes NNS_dep.cpp only in how it orders the quadrant labels (a counting sort giving the same order as the stable sort) and an optional ties hint, so the port is unchanged.

The vendored NNS-core multivariate prediction kernel (src/mreg_predict.cpp, sha256 c98d3fbb93c3165109870cb3d2cc1a55c8cb0fa35770b3ff0204441fd20e1e04) with its Student-t and normal ensemble weights evaluated by R's own nmath dt and dnorm4 (src/nns/_rnmath.hpp) instead of the vendor's lgamma-based closed form, and each distance summed over the columns in long double from double terms as R 14.2's distance() does. R 14.2's exact neighbour search prunes rows that cannot enter the (distance, row) order; the full sort used here selects the same neighbours. CMake replaces only the vendor translation unit.

The vendored NNS-core partial-moment kernels (src/partial_moments.cpp, sha256 8786f5df1fcd8e29c6ea28d91903fbdbaa93ed93a803d924422a89a19e23bdb0) with d_upm's two mixed-degree branches matched to R's DUPM_C: when exactly one degree is an integer, repeated multiplication goes to that degree's side and pow to the other. The vendor had them swapped, so native D.UPM ignored the fractional degree. CMake replaces only the vendor translation unit. R 14.2 (r_commit) changes src/partial_moments.cpp only by the zero-total normalisation tracked with src/nns/_r14_pm_norm.cpp; DUPM_C is unchanged.

R14 NNS.seas lag scan: SeasComponent and seas_score copied verbatim, scored across lags with nns::parallel_for in place of RcppParallel (each lag writes its own slot, so results never depend on the thread count). Built into the NNS-core library target for its Release optimisation; bound as seas_scores_r14.

R 14.2 zero-total normalisation for scalar and batched nD co-partial moments and PM.matrix (degree-0 values when the normalising total is 0), declared in src/nns/_r14_pm_norm.hpp. Uses the vendored raw moment and matrix kernels. The r_source file is unchanged at r_commit.

r_cache_summary.generation: Every entry regenerated with scripts/regenerate_r_cache.py --fresh from live R 4.5.0 (CRAN r-base-core 4.5.0-3.2404.0, reference BLAS/LAPACK) with NNS_14.2.tar.gz at f0387ed. The entries shared with the builder's regeneration at bb05d3d (automation/r-cache-nns-14.2) are byte-identical.
